description: High-Performance DOT 4 Formula: Advanced brake & clutch fluid designed to deliver smooth braking response and reliable stopping power under high-temperature conditions. Compatible with ABS Systems: Specially formulated for modern ABS, disc brake, and drum brake systems to ensure efficient and safe braking performance. Suitable for Hydraulic Clutch Systems: Provides smooth clutch operation and consistent hydraulic pressure for enhanced driving comfort and control. High Boiling Point Protection: Helps resist vapor lock and brake failure during heavy braking, long drives, and extreme driving conditions. Protects Against Rust & Corrosion: Anti-corrosion additives help protect brake lines, cylinders, and internal components for longer system life. Excellent Thermal & Oxidation Stability: Maintains fluid performance over extended use while reducing sludge and deposit formation. Wide Vehicle Compatibility: Ideal for cars, motorcycles, scooters, commercial vehicles, and other vehicles requiring DOT 4 brake fluid. Easy Pour 500ML Pack: Convenient packaging for hassle-free topping up and maintenance of brake and clutch systems.
